The '''Holocron Machine''' was a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based device created by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:DD" /> Based on a similar machine built centuries ago by [[Darth Nul]] on [[Elom_(planet)/Legends|Elom]],<ref name="Disorder">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220215-0|text="Disorder"|int=Disorder}}</ref> it used the knowledge of [[Darth Nul's holocron]] to turn modest [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] into powerful [[Force Adept|Force adepts]]. The Hidden Chain leader [[Heta Kol]] intended to use the machine to create an army of Force-sensitive soldiers.<ref name="TOR:DD" /> However, the Holocron Machine was eventually destroyed when the [[Eternal Alliance]] [[Mission to Hidden Chain Ship|destroyed]] the [[Hidden Chain flagship|starship]] that transported the device.<ref name="TOR:Sundering" />
